top_signals.title: Hundreds still missing in Colombia as desperation grips earthquake rescue effort
top_signals.summary: Crews began shifting from a search-and-rescue effort to debris removal at many sites, a sign ​the disaster response was entering a grimmer phase after the crucial first 72 hours.

top_signals.title: Iga Swiatek cruises past Elena Rybakina to capture Canadian Open title
top_signals.summary: The Pole was sharp and fast on the hard ⁠court in Toronto while ​Kazakhstan's Rybakina was her own enemy for much of the ​evening.
